about: Download the FREE FINAL FANTASY CRYSTAL CHRONICLES Remastered Edition Lite to enjoy the first three dungeons of the full game, be it alone or with your friends in online multiplayer. You can even join a caravan hosted by a player who has purchased the full game to play together in up to 13 dungeons- all for free!

FINAL FANTASY® CRYSTAL CHRONICLES™ Remastered Edition is an enchanting action RPG that follows a young group, known as the Crystal Caravanners, as they embark on an epic journey to search for myrrh, a precious and rare liquid needed to cleanse and maintain a crystal protecting their world from the deadly gas, miasma.
Enlist comrades to your crystal caravan in online multiplayer mode with up to four players.
Increased difficulty post-game dungeons, and more!
